newsitem.title: INDIA: Delhi shares post gains on short cover, buying.
newsitem.headline: Delhi shares post gains on short cover, buying.

text.p: Delhi shares closed higher on Friday on short covering by speculators coupled with buying by financial institutions, brokers said.
The Delhi sensitive index closed 4.03 points higher at 728.56. Friday was the last day of the current settlement period.
"Huge short covering by bear operators indicates that the market was in over-sold positions, which mainly contributed to the rally in prices," Ajit Sial of brokers Sial & Co said.
There was hectic trading in many blue chips, brokers said.
Reliance Industries added 5.25 rupees to 273.50 mainly on short covering and buying by traders, brokers said.
ITC Ltd gained 12 rupees to 396, after dipping to 376.50 rupees in early deals, on buying by foreign institutional investors (FIIs) and traders, they said.
Tisco edged up 1.15 rupees to 186.50 while ICICI shot up 25 rupees to 62 on selective buying by FIIs.
Bajaj Auto added 3.40 rupees to 924.90 and Arvind Mills rose two rupees to 134.
Colgate Palmolive went up 6.50 rupees to 271.50.
Hero Honda Motors Ltd rose 13 rupees to 298 and Grasim quoted 10 rupees higher to close at 406.
State Bank of India dropped 1.05 rupees to 267.20 on late selling.
Larsen and Toubro ended 0.05 rupee down at 233.45.
